items.title: US envoys say Europeans will be included in upcoming Ukraine peace talks
items.description: Europe has been demanding a seat at the negotiating table for several months, but Moscow has not yet formally agreed. Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, Donald Trump's special envoys, left Moscow on Thursday with very little new information on the negotiations between Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: Europe to Join Next Ukraine Peace Talks Following US-Putin Meeting
items.description: European representatives will participate in the next round of Ukraine-Russia peace negotiations, President Volodymyr Zelensky and US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff said Thursday, Nov. 12, following talks with Vladimir Putin in Moscow. Zelensky said the agenda would include ceasefires and de-escalation measures…

items.title: EU leaders tussle over who to send to Ukraine, Russia peace talks
items.description: A seat at the table for Europe now appears likely following comments by a US envoy who just held talks with Putin. But who will take that seat remains unclear.

items.title: Russia's Vladimir Putin suggests no Ukraine compromise in meeting with US envoys
items.description: Russia's President Vladimir Putin indicated on Thursday, November 12, that the Kremlin would not compromise on its hardline demands to end the war in Ukraine, but offered a short-term ceasefire in a key frontline city during a meeting with US envoys. FRANCE 24's International Affairs Editor Philip Turle has more.

items.title: What Happened At The Ukraine-Russia Peace Talks? Not Much.
